UK Economic Growth Slows Amid Rising Energy Prices

UK economic growth slowed to 0.4% in the three months to June, down from 0.6% in the previous quarter, according to the Office for National Statistics (ONS). The slowdown is attributed in part to rising energy prices, which have been impacted by the conflict in Iran. Despite the slowdown, the economy is described as resilient.
